title: `users.delete(id)` bypasses `Group#remove` — stale `user_count` and 500 on non-members
description: users.delete(id) bypasses Group#remove, causing stale user_count and 500 errors on non-members; delete_all skips counter_cache callback

title: `add_members` raises 500 when a username is already in the group
description: Group#add has no dedupe logic; UNIQUE index on (group_id, user_id) raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique when adding existing member

title: `PATCH /admin/groups/:id` still routes here and now silently hides the group
description: update_patch is gone but PATCH still routes to update action; group.visible set to false for absent visible parameter, silently hiding group

title: `totalPages` off-by-one produces a phantom empty page
description: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 returns 2 for 50 members at limit 50, creating phantom empty page
